name: invoice-total
scope: A small library that totals invoice lines with tax and currency rounding. No user interface; it is published as a package.

install.description: The published package installs in a clean environment and totals the README example

boundary_meaning.ci: The continuous integration run on the merged revision passed
boundary_meaning.published: The package installs from the public index in a clean environment and gives the expected totals

roles.owner: the maintainer who owns the package name

rules.text: Money is computed with decimal arithmetic, never binary floating point.
Every release adds one line to CHANGELOG.md.

exceptions.reason: Spelling and wording fixes are released with the next reviewed change.

data.sensitivity: No personal data; invoice amounts in tests are invented.
